en.text: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华作王！愿地快乐！ 愿众海岛欢喜！

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華作王！願地快樂！ 願眾海島歡喜！

en.text: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

zhSimplified.text: 密云和幽暗在他的四围； 公义和公平是他宝座的根基。

zhTraditional.text: 密雲和幽暗在他的四圍； 公義和公平是他寶座的根基。

en.text: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

zhSimplified.text: 有烈火在他前头行， 烧灭他四围的敌人。

zhTraditional.text: 有烈火在他前頭行， 燒滅他四圍的敵人。

en.text: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

zhSimplified.text: 他的闪电光照世界， 大地看见便震动。

zhTraditional.text: 他的閃電光照世界， 大地看見便震動。

en.text: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

zhSimplified.text: 诸山见耶和华的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蜡。

zhTraditional.text: 諸山見耶和華的面， 就是全地之主的面，便消化如蠟。

en.text: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

zhSimplified.text: 诸天表明他的公义； 万民看见他的荣耀。

zhTraditional.text: 諸天表明他的公義； 萬民看見他的榮耀。

en.text: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

zhSimplified.text: 愿一切事奉雕刻的偶像、 靠虚无之神自夸的，都蒙羞愧。 万神哪，你们都当拜他。

zhTraditional.text: 願一切事奉雕刻的偶像、 靠虛無之神自誇的，都蒙羞愧。 萬神哪，你們都當拜他。

en.text: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，锡安听见你的判断就欢喜； 犹大的城邑也都快乐。

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，錫安聽見你的判斷就歡喜； 猶大的城邑也都快樂。

en.text: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

zhSimplified.text: 因为你—耶和华至高，超乎全地； 你被尊崇，远超万神之上。

zhTraditional.text: 因為你－耶和華至高，超乎全地； 你被尊崇，遠超萬神之上。

en.text: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

zhSimplified.text: 你们爱耶和华的，都当恨恶罪恶； 他保护圣民的性命， 搭救他们脱离恶人的手。

zhTraditional.text: 你們愛耶和華的，都當恨惡罪惡； 他保護聖民的性命， 搭救他們脫離惡人的手。

en.text: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

zhSimplified.text: 散布亮光是为义人； 预备喜乐是为正直人。

zhTraditional.text: 散布亮光是為義人； 預備喜樂是為正直人。

en.text: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

zhSimplified.text: 你们义人当靠耶和华欢喜， 称谢他可记念的圣名。

zhTraditional.text: 你們義人當靠耶和華歡喜， 稱謝他可記念的聖名。
